types.attribution: tf.image.decode_jpeg of a facades-dataset JPEG (paired A|B layout, label half left, photo half right). Empirically measured 2026-08-08 over the complete 2016 facades.tar.gz archive: all 606 JPEGs (400 train, 100 val, 106 test) are 512x256 RGB, so every decode yields (256, 512, 3) uint8. The URL pinned at Pix2Pix.py:25 now returns a GitHub Pages 404; the measurement used the efrosgans.eecs.berkeley.edu mirror of the same archive.
